video_summary.overall_goal: Demonstrate a complete breathing exercise session with navigation to sessions history
video_summary.description: User starts Brethap app, taps 'Press Start', runs breathing exercise (inhale/exhale cycles), pauses/returns to start screen, restarts breathing exercise, then taps hamburger menu to open navigation drawer and navigate to Sessions screen to view past breathing sessions.

steps.system_response: App transitions to breathing exercise screen
steps.visual_feedback: Screen transitions to breathing mode with 'Inhale' instruction and animated circle

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Brethap breathing exercise screen with 'Inhale' instruction, animated blue circle (expanding/contracting), timer counting down from ~0:01:59 to ~0:01:54
visible_ui_elements: Header with hamburger menu icon (≡) and title 'Brethap'
steps.system_response: App runs breathing cycle: Inhale phase (circle expands), Exhale phase (circle contracts), timer counts down
steps.visual_feedback: Blue circle animates in sync with breathing instructions, timer decrements, instruction text alternates between 'Inhale' and 'Exhale'
steps.intent_task: Follow breathing exercise prompts for duration of session

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Returns to start screen: 'Press Start' button, timer reset to '0:02:00'
steps.system_response: Breathing exercise session pauses/ends, app returns to idle start screen
steps.visual_feedback: Screen clears breathing UI, returns to start screen with reset timer
steps.intent_task: Session paused or terminated, return to start state

steps.system_response: App transitions back to breathing exercise screen
steps.visual_feedback: Screen transitions to breathing mode again with 'Inhale' instruction and animated circle

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Breathing exercise in progress: 'Inhale'/'Exhale' alternating, animated blue circle, timer counting down from ~0:01:57 to ~0:01:54
visible_ui_elements: Header with hamburger menu (≡), title 'Brethap', status icons
steps.visual_feedback: Circle animates, instructions alternate, timer counts down

Brethap logo/icon at top of drawer
Breathing activity visible in background (partially obscured)

steps.visual_feedback: Drawer slides in from left, covers part of the screen, menu items become tappable
steps.intent_task: Open navigation menu to access app sections

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Sessions history screen: back arrow in header, title 'Sessions', list of past breathing sessions with dates and durations
visible_ui_elements: Header with back arrow (←), title 'Sessions', status icons
steps.target_element: Sessions menu item in navigation drawer
steps.system_response: App navigates to Sessions screen, displays list of past breathing sessions
steps.visual_feedback: Screen transitions to full sessions list, drawer closes, session history displayed with timestamps and durations
steps.intent_task: View history of past breathing exercise sessions

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Sessions screen remains visible, list now appears empty or loading (last frame shows header only)
steps.system_response: Sessions screen remains idle, no further navigation
steps.visual_feedback: Screen stays on sessions screen, content may be loading or user paused

overall_flow: User launches Brethap app (already open, showing start screen)
Taps 'Press Start' button to initiate breathing exercise
App runs breathing cycle with visual (animated circle) and audio prompts (Inhale/Exhale)
Exercise auto-stops and returns to start screen after ~7 seconds
User immediately taps 'Press Start' again to restart exercise
User taps hamburger menu (≡) icon in header to open navigation
App navigates to Sessions history screen showing past breathing sessions
Video ends with user viewing sessions list
human_readable_step_summary: Start screen displayed with 'Press Start' button and 2-minute timer
User taps 'Press Start' to begin breathing exercise
Breathing exercise runs for ~7 seconds with Inhale/Exhale cycles and animated blue circle guidance
App returns to start screen (exercise ended)
User taps 'Press Start' again to restart the breathing exercise
Second breathing session runs for ~6 seconds with same animation and instruction pattern
User taps hamburger menu icon (≡) to open navigation drawer during breathing
Navigation drawer shows menu options (Preferences, Sessions, Calendar, About Brethap)
User taps 'Sessions' menu item to navigate to session history
Sessions screen displays list of past breathing sessions with dates and durations (e.g., 2026-05-01, 2026-03-24)
